## generic_slot_match_gen1

**Result: Reproduced curriculum ambiguity.** Generator SHA-256 `1daeb71d28dba2ec6e337f74e0af51abed607b9ef1bd467e23eb89c6e2e01744` was left unchanged.

The plausible rival “for each slot class, use the color of the first matching scattered object in reading order” can fit every training pair yet disagree with the intended modal-color rule. Over deterministic seeds `0..999` in each band, it survived all training pairs in 42/1000 easy, 16/1000 medium, and 5/1000 hard tasks. It then disagreed with at least one generated test pair in 34/42, 14/16, and 4/5 of those survivors. Full census and sampler details: `checks/audits/generic_slot_match_gen1_first_object.json`.

The smallest retained example is seed 46, difficulty `easy`. The rival matches both training pairs, then differs on `test[1]`: official modal color `7` versus rival color `9` at output cells `[2,5]` and `[6,3]`. The input came directly from `generate_task`, so it belongs to the documented generated domain; this generic generator has no separate input validator. The exact embedded Racket PROGRAM matches the official output and not the rival (`checks/audits/generic_slot_match_gen1/racket.json`). The generator's broader parity harness also reports 115/115 exact pairs (`checks/audits/generic_slot_match_gen1_parity.log`).

The documented per-puzzle `arcpuzzles apply` route cannot resolve generic-family PROGRAMs; that failed attempt is retained at `checks/audits/generic_slot_match_gen1/racket-apply.log`. The source-bound RacketBridge replay used instead is `checks/audits/generic_slot_match_racket_replay.py`. This finding concerns lesson composition, not Python/Racket rule parity. It is a finite census of one rival, not an exhaustive ambiguity rate.

triage.reason: Short brief and general feedback read under one-minute policy; routine source repair accepted as reviewer-reported. Complete-lesson/replay/override proposals retained; durable output and portable-test subset already implemented. Both audits and unscored solves retained; no training admission.
